user.title: Nice
user.description: Choose an available connection mode. Local + cloud fallback is recommended when cloud transport is available. Cloud routes are encrypted, but the Nice relay uses a self-signed certificate, so its certificate and hostname cannot be verified.

data_description.connection_mode: How Home Assistant should reach this Nice device. Only modes supported by this version are shown.
data_description.credential_source: Enter existing NHK credentials, import from MyNice, pair directly or inspect a provisioning interface.

cloud_auth.title: Import credentials from MyNice
cloud_auth.description: This optional one-time import sends the supplied account details to Nice through the private service and built-in client registration used by MyNice. The service may change. Home Assistant discards the account password and access token after the import.

data.cloud_confirm: I understand this uses a private MyNice service

data_description.cloud_account: Email address or username for the MyNice account.
data_description.cloud_account_password: Used only for this import and never stored in the config entry.
data_description.cloud_confirm: Confirms that you understand the account details leave the LAN and that the MyNice service is private and may change.

cloud_accessories.title: Choose Nice interfaces
cloud_accessories.description: Found {count} unconfigured interface(s). {skipped} incomplete or duplicate record(s) were ignored. Select every interface you want to add.

data_description.cloud_accessories: Each selected interface becomes its own Home Assistant config entry.

cloud_local.title: Connect {name}
cloud_local.description: Configure interface {current} of {total}. The account session has ended; Home Assistant now validates only the imported NHK device credentials through the selected route.

pairing.title: Pair directly with the module
pairing.description: Choose first user only for an unpaired module and enter its printed setup code. For an existing installation, request access and ask its administrator to approve it in MyNice. This explicitly creates a module user; it never resets the device. Direct pairing needs a reachable local TLS address. Administrator access is required for configuration; ordinary users can operate the gate.

data.name: Name
data.confirm_enrollment: Create or resume this Home Assistant access request

pairing_wait.title: Check module approval
pairing_wait.description: The same access identity has been saved. Approve this Home Assistant request in MyNice using an existing administrator account, then select Submit to check with VERIFY. This does not resend PAIR. If delivery was interrupted, keep this identity and check before trying another enrollment method. A returned device password and an active role are required to finish.

pairing_finish.title: Validate approved access
pairing_finish.description: The module returned an active role and a device password. Select Submit to retry the connection test. The pairing request will not be sent again.

network_probe.title: Inspect a provisioning interface
network_probe.description: Read-only WNC INFO and SCAN on a module access point reachable from Home Assistant. Enter its TLS port from the module documentation or discovery. This does not join a Wi-Fi network or save passwords. Wi-Fi configuration is unavailable until AP state, identity and recovery are verified. Existing configured modules are excluded.

data.confirm_probe: Read provisioning information and scan available networks

network_results.title: Provisioning inspection
network_results.description: Reported model: {model}. Networks found: {networks}. No network credentials were collected or configuration changed. Wi-Fi setup is blocked pending verified AP-state and recovery bindings. Continue to choose another setup method.

controller_limits_changed.title: Gate controller changed its travel limits

confirm.title: Accept the new travel limits
confirm.description: The controller open position dropped from {previous} to {current}. This can happen after an abnormal stop. The position shown in Home Assistant follows the controller. Check the gate with the original app. If the travel is wrong, ask the installer to check the controller positions and do not submit this form. Submit only if the installer changed the travel on purpose. The current open position becomes the new reference.

abort.not_loaded: The Nice entry is not loaded or has no open position yet. Try again later.

inspect_users.title: Module access
inspect_users.description:
This integration role: {role}. Approved records: {users}. Pending requests: {pending}. Administrators: {admins}. Roles refer to the module, not cloud ownership. User identifiers are kept out of diagnostics. Continue to return to the menu.

{records}

approve_user.title: Approve a pending request
approve_user.description: Choose an existing pending module request to approve as an ordinary user. Review the person and device before continuing.

edit_user.title: Change module permission
edit_user.description: Choose another approved record. Disabled users remain paired; this does not delete a record or transfer cloud ownership. Current Home Assistant access cannot be changed here.

confirm_access.title: Confirm permission change
confirm_access.description: Change {target} to module permission {role}? The complete list and your administrator role will be checked again immediately before sending. The integration will read back the result and will not replay an uncertain write.

identify.title: Identify the module
identify.description: Submit sends one IDENTIFY request while the gate is confirmed stationary. Its visible effect depends on the module. This does not command gate movement.

installer.title: Installer and lifecycle procedures
installer.description: Choose an inspection or procedure. Workflows without verified transactions and recovery show the missing evidence before any device access. Controller position learning is separate from HA animation calibration.

data.confirm: I reviewed the prerequisites and want to run this operation

installer_recovery.title: Review interrupted procedure
installer_recovery.description: First check the module in the manufacturer app. This acknowledgement can only clear an interface-restart hold after fresh inspection and administrator verification. It does not resend the command or claim the earlier physical restart succeeded. Other procedures need their model-specific recovery adapter.

data.confirm: I checked the module and acknowledge the unresolved outcome

installer_cancel.title: Request cancellation
installer_cancel.description: Stops at a verified boundary between steps only. No guessed abort command is sent. An irreversible submitted request cannot be undone by cancelling HA.

menu_options.ecosystem_ha: What HA and the manufacturer app manage

ecosystem_cloud.title: Read-only Nice cloud inspection
ecosystem_cloud.description: Optional: use a temporary MyNice login to read scene, rule and timer records for this configured accessory. Nothing is imported, modified or executed. Account credentials, tokens and cookies are discarded. Names and exact schedules appear only in this local screen; diagnostics export counts. This inspection is independent of local/cloud fallback policy.

data.confirm: Allow this temporary read-only inspection through Nice’s private cloud service

ecosystem_report.title: Last Nice inspection
ecosystem_report.description:
Captured: {captured_at}. State: {state}. Last attempt error: {last_error}.

These are cloud records, not proof of current CORE execution. Status codes, times and repeats are shown as Nice reports them; timezone has not been verified and HA automations have not been compared. Review possible overlap in the manufacturer app before building an HA equivalent. No record is changed or executed.

{records}

The scope is the configured accessory/gateway; records may refer to other connected devices. Mapping to this specific gate has not been verified.

ecosystem_ha.title: HA remains in charge
ecosystem_ha.description: Use native HA areas, floors, dashboards, groups, scenes/scripts, schedules, automations, notifications and users. Nice exposes verified device controls, measurements and events. It does not import or synchronize MyNice resources or create a second scheduler. Manage vendor ownership, invitations, existing Nice resources and vendor service linking in the manufacturer app. Module access, Nice account permissions and HA users are separate.

ecosystem_controller.title: Controller-owned behavior
ecosystem_controller.description:
Values HA has already read from the controller. No new read or setting change is performed. Unknown does not mean disabled. These functions can operate without HA; review any equivalent HA automation before changing anything. No conflict has been established.

{records}

ecosystem_core.title: CORE table snapshot
ecosystem_core.description: Reads versions, rules and scene tables, then checks versions again. Only counts are retained. This does not prove execution or interpret schedules, and no table is written or executed.

ecosystem_core_result.title: CORE tables read
ecosystem_core_result.description: Captured: {captured_at}. Rules: {rules}. Scene inputs: {scene_inputs}. Scene outputs: {scene_outputs}. Table versions were consistent. These counts do not prove execution or the number of active scenes.

pro_controls.title: Pro controls
pro_controls.description: Show supported settings advertised by your controller. Your Nice account needs administrator access. Enabling this mode does not change any gate setting.

receiver_status.title: Receiver status
receiver_status.description:
Passive inspection; no configuration is changed. Submit to read.

{summary}

receiver_memory.title: Receiver slots
receiver_memory.description:
Bounded read-only inspection. Private remote codes and security counters are not displayed.

{summary}

receiver_protocols.title: Built-in receiver protocols
receiver_protocols.description:
Inspects the controller built-in radio when supported. Checks metadata first, then establishes a temporary session challenge. It does not program remotes or change enabled protocols. The external OXI receiver is a separate device.

{summary}

error.receiver_inspection_failed: Inspection could not complete. Check connectivity, permissions and integration diagnostics.

error.receiver_inspection_interrupted: Inspection yielded to a higher-priority command. Try again while the gate is stationary.

abort.not_loaded: Load the integration before managing module access.
abort.no_access_targets: No eligible records were found. Current Home Assistant access is excluded.
abort.network_workflow_unverified: Wi-Fi changes are unavailable: AP-state, identity and operational rediscovery/recovery are not verified. Use the manufacturer app. No network password has been collected.
abort.ownership_workflow_unverified: Manage cloud ownership and sharing in the manufacturer app. Physical deletion of module pairing records still lacks a verified transaction and recovery path. Promoting another module user to administrator is a separate operation.
abort.installer_cancel_unavailable: The current step cannot be safely cancelled. No abort request was sent.
abort.ecosystem_core_unverified: CORE table/version/runtime inspection has no verified adapter. Cloud copies can be stale and do not prove device execution. No transport was started and no credentials were collected.
abort.ecosystem_core_requires_core: This configured endpoint is not CORE. Table inspection requires an explicitly identified CORE endpoint. A documented standalone reader supports existing CORE credentials; this gate is not probed.
